components.title: MEOK OS Web (PWA, 130 sovereign pages)
components.description: The sovereign client surface. 130+ HTML pages delivered as a PWA. Includes the Cesium 3D public site (meok-world-3d.html), the 5D breakthrough (meok-breakthrough.html), the 13-Queen council live chat (council-live.html), the 7-archetype character emergence (meok-character-emergence.html), the legacy-system demo (legacy-demo.html) for COBOL/SAP/HL7/SWIFT bridges, and the i-character wizard (ichar-wizard-live.html) that POSTs to /api/ichar/create. All pages carry the emergence CSS (translucent eggs + golden core + iridescent), the PWA manifest, the CSP, and the 6 care-dimension Maternal Covenant.

components.title: Backend FastAPI (meok-backend/app.py)
components.description: Python FastAPI server (20+ endpoints) running on MEOK backend (port 8000, production bind to 0.0.0.0). Provides /api/backend/status, /api/ichar/create, /api/ichar/<id>/avatar (200x300 SVG), /api/council/chat (queen voice + 4-tier cascade), /api/sigil/verify (audit chain verify), /api/perf/{track,stats}, /api/geo (IP-based region detection). Built with FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLite, Uvicorn. All writes SIGIL-signed.

components.title: MCP Server — meok-bio-lookup (PubMed + ClinicalTrials.gov)

Every result SIGIL-signed. Used by MEOK Labs Research Hatch.
components.purpose: Sovereign-signed research artifact service. Wraps real bio APIs so the MEOK Hatch can deliver verifiable provenance for any query.

components.title: Defoneos-sign MCP (model-context-protocol signing)
components.description: MCP server exposing 6 tools: sign_file(path, sha256) → SIGIL receipt; verify_signature(receipt_id) → bool + metadata; list_receipts(limit=100); get_sovereign_version → {version, sigil_head, api_url}; health_check; get_audit_log(filter_date, limit=100). Runs on stdio (JSON-RPC 2.0), all ops SIGIL-signed, all ops audit-logged. Used by any agent to sign any artifact with the MEOK Defoneos-secure SIGIL chain.
components.purpose: Sovereign artifact signing. Lets any agent (including Claude Science, AutoGPT, Hermes, LangChain, etc.) sign any output with MEOK provenance.

components.title: Launch Script + Quality Gate (launch.sh + quality_gate.py)
components.description: The 9-step pre-launch sequence: pre-flight checks, build verification, test run, backend deployment, SOV3 substrate verification, live smoke test (5 flows, 13 steps), pages verification (130 with emergence CSS), PWA files check (6/6), and final report. Plus quality_gate.py — 13/13 checks: pages count, PWA files, breakthrough pages, backend live, SOV3 live, 7 archetypes referenced, 14 queens referenced, 22 arcana referenced, 11 temples referenced, 6 care dimensions, 8 sovereign guarantees, live smoke, all tests.

components.title: 4-Tier Cascade (T1 Edge → T4 Strategic, $0.011/avg)
